title: Rosalind and the House
author: Marguerite Sandoval
blurb: Jude Ravensworth, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
